candidate_semantics.atom_identity: opaque structural candidate only; element and chemistry fields are forbidden
candidate_semantics.atom_pair_binding: every bond retains a canonical unordered atom_pair and its begin port belongs to atom_pair[0]
candidate_semantics.atom_policy: every atom is explicitly classified as explicit_label or implicit_vertex; explicit labels retain glyph fragment IDs
candidate_semantics.boundary_support_policy: every boundary retains both final-foreground support and bond-mask support as canonical RLE
candidate_semantics.boundary_policy: enumerate every compatible bounded matching including legal unmatched boundaries
candidate_semantics.compatible_pair_geometry_formula: angle=half-up acute millidegrees; centerline=componentwise half-up mean of canonical corresponding endpoints; separation=half-up mean of the two integer endpoint distances; overlap=dominant-axis interval overlap scaled by left boundary Euclidean length; shorter_overlap_ppm=half-up overlap/min(boundary lengths)
candidate_semantics.compatible_pair_policy: emit the root boundary universe and every compatible pair with recomputable integer geometry, observable raster statistics and canonical centerline; matchings reference only compatible-pair IDs and validators bind local boundary replay to the root universe
candidate_semantics.crossing_policy: retain both through-line and split-junction interpretations when both satisfy observable constraints
candidate_semantics.intersection_policy: every crossing, junction or touch region is named; port_member_ids are exactly ports with referenced endpoints inside region support; crossing has no connecting port and junction has at least one
candidate_semantics.interpretation_locality: boundaries, fragments, ownership, atoms, ports, lanes, bonds and gap certificates are local to one interpretation
candidate_semantics.model_score_policy: observation-derived scores may be recorded after integer quantization but may not delete candidates
candidate_semantics.endpoint_atom_policy: every in-gate endpoint-to-atom alternative is emitted with squared-distance gating plus integer Q8 outward-dot and absolute-cross evidence; outward_dot_q8 must be nonnegative
candidate_semantics.direct_pair_policy: the full bounded Direct AtomPair universe is emitted; positive intersection is abolished and negative or uncertain decisions never delete a physical candidate
candidate_semantics.empty_graph_policy: atoms, ports, endpoint relations, lanes and bonds may all be empty so glyph-only and charge-only interpretations remain expressible
candidate_semantics.graph_equivalence_policy: the frozen spatial-graph quotient is emitted in full and never authorizes a unique graph in v0.3
candidate_semantics.lane_separation_policy: white-gap and lane-separation support must equal the complete deterministic set of white pixel centers within boundary_support_width_q4 of the certified span; lane-separation span is the two lane midpoint segment and min/max are the paired outer-endpoint distances
candidate_semantics.mask_policy: root image stores complete final-foreground, bond-mask and text-mask canonical RLE, three independent SHA256 values and the exact framing identifier
candidate_semantics.ownership_policy: enumerate every legal bond_lane, text_glyph, marker, charge and residual assignment
candidate_semantics.primitive_kind_policy: v0.3 admits only straight, glyph, charge and unknown; wedge, circle, curve and whole dashed primitives reject as unsupported_primitive
candidate_semantics.stage_trace_policy: root output carries the exact 12-stage order, contiguous indices, frozen component SHA256, previous-output input chaining, actual framed root-artifact output hashes, record counts and one ordered-chain SHA256
candidate_semantics.support_policy: support must be nonwhite input foreground and is uniquely owned only within each interpretation
candidate_semantics.white_gap_policy: every non-touching adjacent fragment pair in a lane requires a certificate bound to the final PNG with explicit raster support and span

execution.input_transport: one canonical JSON document on stdin
execution.output_transport: one canonical JSON document on stdout
execution.replay_policy: byte-exact replay is a pre-freeze public-input reproducibility test only; blind input receives exactly one authoritative run

input.canonical_png_profile: noninterlaced 8-bit grayscale with IHDR, contiguous IDAT and IEND only

runner_failure_policy: unexpected exceptions are recorded outside the proposer output schema and never encoded as reject
